name: thedeployer
description: Deploy and run this app in your own AWS, Google Cloud, Azure or DigitalOcean account, or move it off Heroku, Railway, Render or Vercel.

settings.name: The Deployer API key
settings.description: A personal key from your Profile page in The Deployer. Choose Operate to let the agent set up and launch projects. Without a key, only check_repo and guide work.
